userStories.title: Pure backlog list-view derivation in src/issues/list.ts
userStories.description: As the cam CLI, I need a pure function that derives the actionable-backlog view (grouped by stage in lifecycle order, shipped/abandoned excluded, sorted, with unmet-blocker annotations) from an IssueEntry[] so that cam issue list and its tests share one deterministic derivation with no I/O.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure helper in src/issues/list.ts derives the backlog view: groups open issues by stage in lifecycle order (idea, specified, planned); stage:shipped and status:abandoned entries are excluded by default; an includeShipped option appends a shipped group. Verified on a mixed-stage fixture asserting group membership and counts. [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts]

A fixture issue with stage:'shipped' AND status:'open' does NOT appear in the default view (the CAM-139 regression case: 140 shipped issues today keep status:open, so the filter MUST key on stage, never on status). [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts]

Within each stage group, entries sort by rank ascending (rank is the issue priority concept, 1 first), ranked entries before unranked, tie-break numeric id suffix ascending, mirroring selectPlannableIssue sort semantics in src/issues/select.ts. [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts]

Each view entry exposes its unmet blockers: the blockedBy ids whose backlog entry exists with stage !== 'shipped' (isBlocked semantics from src/issues/graph.ts), so the renderer can print a [blocked: X] marker. [oracle: bun test test/issues/list.test.ts]

userStories.title: runIssueList command core: deterministic read + render + backend branch
userStories.description: As an operator, I need cam issue list to print the actionable backlog by reading issues from main and rendering a grouped table in-process so that the backlog listing is deterministic (no claude, no tmux) and correct from any branch.
acceptanceCriteria: runIssueList (new src/commands/issue-list.ts) reads issue_system from scripts/cam/project.toml (missing file or key defaults to 'none', mirroring the ship-finalize.ts read pattern); for 'none' it reads the backlog via readBacklogFromMain (git ls-tree + cat-file from the main ref, never a raw fs read of the working dir) and renders the US-001 view through the src/logging linear print helpers with an injectable writer seam. [oracle: bun test test/issue-list.test.ts]

Rendered rows show: priority (the rank field; blank when unranked), id, a [blocked: <ids>] marker when unmet blockers exist, and the title truncated to a column budget; stage groups render as headings in lifecycle order. Verified on a mixed fixture asserting the marker and truncation. [oracle: bun test test/issue-list.test.ts]
An --all option includes the shipped group; the default view excludes shipped and abandoned. [oracle: bun test test/issue-list.test.ts]

issue_system 'linear' or 'github' prints a short hint pointing at the native UI (the Linear app / gh issue list) and returns exit 0, never hard-fails. Verified per backend. [oracle: bun test test/issue-list.test.ts]

Deterministic: a recording fake spawn injected as the only subprocess seam proves no tmux operation (no send-keys, no list-panes, no pane spawn) and no claude spawn is ever invoked; the only spawn usage is the git ls-tree/cat-file pair inside readBacklogFromMain (injectable BacklogSpawnFn). [oracle: bun test test/issue-list.test.ts]

userStories.title: CLI surface: parse cam issue list, route in dispatchIssue, help text
userStories.description: As an operator, I need cam issue list (and --all) recognized as a deterministic subcommand of cam issue, without breaking cam issue "<text>" = create, so that the list path never reaches the thin-proxy send-keys machinery.
acceptanceCriteria: parseIssueArgs (index.ts) returns a new discriminated-union member { mode: 'list', all: false, help: false } for cam issue list and { mode: 'list', all: true, help: false } for cam issue list --all; the list branch is evaluated BEFORE the free-text fallthrough. [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]

cam issue "<free text>" (e.g. 'fix the flaky retry test') still parses to mode 'text', and --file-local parsing (including --fast-track / --derived-from) is unchanged; both covered by unit tests (no regression). [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]

dispatchIssue routes mode 'list' to runIssueList via an injectable dep (issueListFn in IssueDispatchDeps); a unit test proves the list branch NEVER invokes runIssueFn or fileLocalFn (no thin-proxy, no send-keys, no claude spawn). [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]
cam issue --help documents the list subcommand and the --all flag. [oracle: bun index.ts issue --help | grep -q -- '--all']
No --permission-mode flag is registered (existing invariant). [oracle: bun test test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts]
